engine_vs_curve.note: engine hit is cumulative over prefill + 256 tokens on one prompt (BigMoeOnEdge moe-cache line); the curve is wikitext, steady state. A coarse check, not S9.

q4_entropy.note: zeroth-order (memoryless) entropy: an upper bound on what any order-0 entropy coder saves; context models could do a little better, never worse than this bound says
